headline: Nevish Line Evens as Posts Change Hands
war_summary: Since the last edition, Nevish Line has moved to an even four-to-four division, with no unheld strategic base; the previous count was four Warden, three Colonial and one unheld. Two event rows fell there in the latest two hours, after heavier earlier churn. Linn’s Mercy remains at eight Colonial, two Warden and one unheld, but logged three rows in the same short window, amid sharply accelerating casualty totals on both sides. Weathered Expanse is unchanged at five Colonial, one Warden and three unheld, yet six event rows in two hours mark a fresh burst of reversals and neutralizations. Mooring County, eleven Warden to one Colonial, also logged three recent rows and sharply rising casualty counts. Marban Hollow’s mixed four-Warden, three-Colonial, one-unheld map has gone quiet in the latest two hours after 19 events over the day; Stonecradle likewise has no fresh two-hour event after six in six hours. Callahan’s Passage retains enormous cumulative casualty totals, but its recent rates have cooled and no base events appear. War 140 remains undecided; 34 victory towns are required.
